summary: This Form 8-K filing by Primis Financial Corp. reports its Q1 2026 financial results, provides an investor presentation, and declares a regular dividend. There is no indication of a special situation such as a merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or forced management change. The filing is a routine current report of operational and financial updates.
